bagPolicy.summary: The Crystal Ballroom site and event guidance do not publish a general bag-size or bag-type rule.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue lists nearby metered street spaces, the Brewery Blocks garage with entrances on 12th and 13th Avenues, and public lots near SW 13th Avenue and Washington Street.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue directions and parking page do not specify a rideshare pickup or drop-off area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The ballroom has bar service; its venue event page describes available beverages and the attached McMenamins dining options. The site does not state a general outside-food admission policy for shows.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue’s official event information says an elevator is in the lobby; guests needing an accommodation may call the ballroom in advance to arrange early entry.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The ballroom’s official venue and event pages do not state a general re-entry rule.

ticketPickup.summary: The Crystal Ballroom box office operates daily 11:30 a.m.–6 p.m. and later on performance nights. Tickets purchased directly at that box office incur a facility charge according to the venue event page.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
